first_repeat_examples.message: Your objectives are bread, a cookie, and a hay bale (hay_block). Mine are paper, a golden apple, and sugar. I have 1 apple and 5 gold ingots, so I still need 3 gold ingots and sugar cane.
I'll gather wheat for bread and a hay bale, and look for cocoa beans and wheat for the cookie.
You need bread, a cookie, and a hay bale. Your 3 gold plus my 5 covers the golden apple—please tell me my assigned items too!
Your card says you need paper, a golden apple, and sugar. I need bread, a cookie, and a hay bale.
Your objective is bread, cookie, and a hay bale. I’ll gather wheat and cocoa beans for you.
Your items are paper, a golden apple, and sugar. I need bread, a cookie, and a hay bale—please gather wheat and cocoa beans for those.
I have paper and sugar, plus an apple and 5 gold ingots. Have you found wheat/cocoa or any gold?
You need to hold sugar, a golden apple, and paper. I need bread, pumpkin pie, and a hay bale.
I have 5 gold and an apple; please give me your 3 gold ingots so I can craft the golden apple. I’ve got my sugar and paper.
You need sugar, a golden apple, and paper. I have 3 gold ingots; the golden apple needs 8. I need bread, pumpkin pie, and a hay bale.
I have 5 gold ingots and an apple, so I just need 3 more gold for my golden apple. I’ll find sugar and paper.
I’ll work on bread, pumpkin pie, and a hay bale. Do you have any wheat, pumpkins, eggs, or sugar to spare?
You need sugar, a golden apple, and paper. I have 3 gold ingots; can you find an apple and more gold? Please tell me my objective too.
Your objective is bread, pumpkin pie, and a hay bale. I have an apple and 5 gold ingots, so I’ll work on my golden apple.
I need wheat for bread and a hay bale, plus pumpkin, egg, and sugar for pie. Please pass over any wheat, pumpkin, egg, or sugar you find.
You need paper, a golden apple, and sugar. Paper needs 3 sugar cane; sugar needs 1, and the apple needs 8 gold ingots plus an apple. I have 3 gold ingots so far.
I have 5 gold ingots and an apple, so I need 3 more ingots plus sugar cane for paper and sugar. I'll check supply chests.
I have 8 sugar cane, 1 apple, and 5 gold ingots. Could you pass me your 3 gold ingots so I can make the golden apple?
I need paper, sugar, and a golden apple. I have an apple and 5 gold ingots; could you look for 3 more gold ingots while I find sugarcane?
I have paper and golden apple; still need sugar. Can you check nearby chests for sugar or sugar cane?
You need to hold paper, a golden apple, and sugar. Paper takes 3 sugar cane; golden apple takes 1 apple and 8 gold ingots; sugar takes 1 sugar cane. What are my objectives?
Your objectives are orange_dye, pink_dye, and purple_dye. I’ll gather sugar cane for mine.
